Uber will invest in Verne; shares slid ~0.7% after news.Analyze the impactAnalyze the impactNet income / Employee (1Y)About Uber Technologies, Inc. Uber Technologies, Inc provides a platform that allows users to access transportation and food ordering services. The Company operates through two segments: Core Platform and Other Bets. The Core Platform segment consists of Ridesharing and Uber Eats. The Other bets segment consists of Uber Freight and New Mobility platforms. Ridesharing refers to products that connects consumers with drivers who provide rides in a variety of vehicles, such as cars, auto rickshaws, motorbikes, minibuses and taxis. Its Uber Eats platform allows consumers to search for and discover local restaurants and order meals through online. Its Freight platform creates a transparent and on-demand marketplace that connects shippers and carriers. New Mobility product that provide consumers with access to rides through a variety of modes, including dockless e-bikes and e-scooters.Related stocks Check out other big names from the same industry
